profile.name: Sambhav Surana
profile.tagline: Agentic AI Systems · Agent Harnesses & Tool Orchestration · Python & Full-stack Development
profile.summary: I build agentic systems and the harnesses around them: tool routing, bounded execution loops, task state, safety policies, and verification. My projects span local-first voice and computer-use agents, stateful complaint-processing workflows with human review, and semantic video search with visual verification. I also explore privacy-preserving IoT system design and transformer compression. I work primarily with Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, and Next.js.

projects.title: NEXUS — Voice & Computer-Use Agent
projects.description: Local-first voice and computer-use agent with bounded plan–act–verify execution, typed tool routing, task state, independent safety policies, confirmation gates, and audit logs.

projects.title: QPilot — AI Complaint Intelligence
projects.description: Stateful LangGraph workflow that converts pharmaceutical complaint text and PDFs into structured records, with classification, risk recommendations, conversational corrections, schema validation, human review, and audit trails.

projects.title: Digital Witness — Semantic Video Search
projects.description: CCTV preparation and natural-language search with semantic retrieval, chat, visual frame verification, background jobs, retries, recovery, and capability reporting. Temporal-event reasoning remains deferred.

projects.title: PrivacyGate AI — Privacy-Preserving IoT Intelligence
projects.description: Design/specification-stage project for owner-controlled sharing of AI-derived IoT anomaly insights. Proposed architecture combines local inference, deterministic disclosure policy, encrypted delivery, and on-chain grant/revoke permissions. Implementation and validation are planned.

projects.title: AI Knowledge Graph Builder
projects.description: Ingests PDF and DOCX documents into a searchable knowledge graph, with semantic search, citation-grounded chat, and interactive graph visualization.

projects.title: Real-Time AI Face Recognition System
projects.description: High-throughput face tracking system using YOLOv11 and Vector Database retrieval with multi-process architecture.

projects.title: Prime-Paradox (CampusCare)
projects.description: Intelligent medical ecosystem connecting patients and doctors via Multi-Agent AI with secure messaging.

projects.title: Weighted Low-Rank Compression
projects.description: Empirical research into activation-aware low-rank compression of transformer attention-output projections, comparing quality, residual drift, storage, and CPU/GPU execution. Current results document tradeoffs and limitations; no consistent acceleration is established.
